title: The Jacobian Conjecture
exact_target: Does every polynomial map of complex affine space whose Jacobian determinant is a nonzero constant have a polynomial inverse? The assertion quantifies over all positive dimensions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 54 (SMA-016). CC BY 4.0.
Shuhong Gao, Counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture in Dimensions Greater Than Two, arXiv:2608.00222v1 (2026), Section 1, formulation of the historical conjecture, pages 1--2.
